# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers of Hybrisa Metropolitan, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Notices run free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]ROOM TO LET[/bold], Westhaven north block, end of the hall. The roof leaks only when it rains, which is always. Bucket included. Ask at the recreation hub. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], a quiet bed near the freight hub for a TMCC cargo hand. Works nights, sleeps days, owns no radio. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Seegson housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]LINE HANDS WANTED[/bold] at the Meridian factory floor. Steady work, staff discount on a car you will never afford. - [bold]SUBSTATION TECHNICIAN[/bold] sought for the DynaGrid Nexus night crew. Must hold a high voltage ticket and keep calm in a brownout. - [bold]DEALERS AND DOOR STAFF[/bold] for the Night Gold Casino. Good tips, late hours, no questions asked or answered.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]RAIN COAT[/bold], Company issue, hood intact, wings logo mostly picked off. Twenty credits or trade for real coffee. - [bold]MONO-SUPRON[/bold], blue, runs, dented door from a TMCC hauler that did not stop. Seen at the garage on the south street.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: checkpoint pass on Central Street, made out to a Westhaven east resident. The guards will not let her home without it. Please hand in at the Ironbridge Precinct front desk. - [bold]FOUND[/bold]: one umbrella outside Cuppa Joe's at the space-port. Yes, just the one. Collect it at the press office.
## Notices - Pizza Galaxy Outpost Zeta delivers to every street in the Metropolitan, but not past a Company checkpoint after curfew. Order early.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
